domains.name: Fishing & Collections
domains.promise: Members cast a play-money Fishing Rod with /fish cast to reel in weighted, rarity-tiered species from the guild catch table, auto-selling each catch for play-money coins while heavier catches and rarer bait pay more; every discovered species fills a per-member collection that pays a one-time completion bonus, and an atomic per-user cooldown paces the loop. Every rod, bait, catch value, junk sale, treasure haul, and collection bonus is play-money only inside the fake game economy — a commerce-granted item or a commerce-held role earns no fishing income, and no catch is ever sellable on the real paid store.

controls.description: Master switch for fishing, backed by the economy_fishing_enabled guild_config key; when off, /fish subcommands explain the feature is disabled and no catch is recorded.
Seconds a member must wait between successful casts, backed by economy_fishing_cooldown_seconds and enforced by an atomic Valkey SET NX claim keyed to guild and user.
Percent chance a cast pulls up junk (old boot, seaweed, tin can) instead of a fish, backed by economy_fishing_junk_chance_pct; junk plus treasure must not exceed 100.
Percent chance a cast surfaces a treasure chest (ancient coin, pearl, golden ring) paying bonus play coins, backed by economy_fishing_treasure_chance_pct; junk plus treasure must not exceed 100.
Whether completing the full per-member species collection pays a one-time play-money bonus; when off, collections still fill and display but the completion bonus is not paid.
Play-money coin bonus paid exactly once when a member discovers every active species in the guild catch table.

defaults.rationale: Fishing is a flagship casual game-economy loop and ships on for the maximal out-of-box experience.
A gentle 30-second pace keeps casting rewarding and grindy without letting a member farm coins in a tight loop.
A modest 15 percent junk rate adds variety and quick early wins without souring the catch feel.
A rare 5 percent treasure chance gives an occasional exciting payout while keeping the sum well under 100.
The completion bonus rewards long-term mastery and ships on; owners can switch the piece off independently.
A meaningful but recoverable play-coin bonus that honors the grind of discovering every species; fully owner-tunable.

permissions.action: Run /fish cast, /fish sell, /fish collection, and /fish leaderboard
permissions.enforcement: Fishing slash commands respond for every member; cast, sell, and collection only ever read or mutate the invoking member's own catches, inventory, and wallet rows.

permissions.actor: Dashboard user with owner or admin access to the guild
permissions.action: Edit fishing settings on the dashboard economy fishing page
permissions.enforcement: Dashboard session auth plus Supabase RLS restrict guild_config writes to authorized guild administrators.

permissions.action: Cast, sell, or claim a collection bonus on behalf of another member
permissions.enforcement: Every fishing handler resolves catches, cooldown keys, and wallet credits by the invoking member's own id; no code path awards a catch or credit to another member.

permissions.actor: A member holding only a commerce-granted role or a commerce-purchased item
permissions.action: Earn fishing play-coin income from that role or sell a fishing catch on the real paid store
permissions.enforcement: Fishing rewards flow solely through the play-money economy_add_balance ledger; commerce roles and commerce-granted items confer no catch, no wallet credit, and no real-store sell path.

messages.trigger: A member's /fish cast lands a fish and auto-sells it for play coins
messages.audience: The casting member and the channel
messages.defaultTemplate: Nice cast — you landed a {species-name} weighing {weight} and sold it for {value} play coins!

messages.trigger: A member discovers the final missing species and the collection is complete
messages.surface: Channel embed replying to /fish cast or /fish collection
messages.audience: The completing member and the channel
messages.defaultTemplate: Incredible, {member-name} — you've discovered every fish in the collection and earned a {reward} play-coin completion bonus!

messages.trigger: A member runs /fish cast while their per-user cooldown is still active
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: Easy there {member-name}, your line needs a rest — you can cast again {retry-time}.

messages.trigger: The play-money wallet credit fails after a catch was recorded
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: Your catch was logged, {member-name}, but the play-coin credit hiccuped — nothing was lost and it will be paid on retry.

messages.trigger: The fishing backend is temporarily unreachable when a member runs a fishing command
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: The waters are choppy right now, {member-name} — give it a moment and cast again.

messages.trigger: A fishing play-money payout keeps failing
messages.defaultTemplate: Heads up: a {value}-coin fishing payout to {member-name} failed and is queued for operator retry; nothing was double-paid and everything is logged.

values.description: Fishing is enabled and the member's per-user cooldown is clear; /fish cast will attempt a catch.
A recent successful cast holds the atomic Valkey cooldown claim; further casts are refused until it expires.
The member owns no Fishing Rod; /fish cast is refused with a prompt to buy one from the play-money /shop, and no cooldown or bait is consumed.
The member has discovered every active species and, when enabled, the one-time collection completion bonus has been paid exactly once.
Fishing disabled by configuration; /fish subcommands explain the feature is off and no catch is recorded.

transitions.trigger: A member with a Fishing Rod runs /fish cast
transitions.expectedEffect: Exactly one fish, junk, or treasure catch resolves, at most one bait is atomically consumed, the wallet is credited exactly once, and the cooldown is claimed atomically via SET NX.

transitions.trigger: A member without a Fishing Rod runs /fish cast
transitions.expectedEffect: The cast is refused with the branded /shop prompt; no catch is recorded, no bait is consumed, and no cooldown is claimed.

transitions.trigger: The member buys a Fishing Rod from the play-money /shop
transitions.expectedEffect: The next /fish cast passes the rod check and proceeds to a catch.
The Valkey cooldown key expires and the member may cast again with no leftover state.

transitions.trigger: The catch that discovers the final missing species completes the collection while fishing-collection-reward-enabled is on
transitions.expectedEffect: The one-time completion bonus of fishing-collection-reward-coins is credited exactly once under an idempotency key and the completion embed posts.

transitions.trigger: Owner turns fishing-enabled off on the dashboard
transitions.expectedEffect: /fish subcommands reply with the disabled explanation; catch history, collections, and wallets are preserved untouched.
Casting resumes with all prior catch history and collection progress intact.

failures.trigger: economy_add_balance fails after the economy_fish_catches row was inserted
failures.expectedBehavior: The catch record flags the credit as unpaid, the result embed plainly states the wallet credit failed instead of pretending success, the payout is queued for operator retry under one idempotency key, and no catch is ever double-credited.

failures.trigger: The play-money economy_add_balance credit for the collection completion bonus fails after the final species is discovered
failures.expectedBehavior: The completion is not marked paid, the bonus stays owed and is retried under one idempotency key so the member is paid exactly once, and the member is never double-rewarded.

failures.trigger: A fishing command hits a transient Supabase or Valkey error
failures.expectedBehavior: The command replies with the branded unavailable message without crashing the bot, no wallet moves and no bait is consumed, no cooldown is wrongly persisted, and a clean retry after recovery casts and credits exactly once.

The owner alert channel receives no alert on this scenario's happy path and exactly one reasoned alert whenever the scenario exercises a failure branch.
Every member-facing fishing surface in this scenario shows the owner's configured brand name, colors, and voice preset with the subtle powered-by-SomniBot attribution and zero stock-bot wording.

Re-delivering this scenario's triggering events yields no duplicate play-money credits, catch rows, or collection-reward payouts; persisted idempotency keys show exactly one effect per logical action.
